plainLanguage: Section 80 — Preventing or obstructing making of proclamation — ni sehemu ya mfumo wa Chapter IX unaohusu unlawful assemblies, riots na public tranquility.
meaning: It separately addresses forcible prevention/obstruction of the proclamation and continued participation with knowledge that proclamation was prevented.
keyPoints: Forcible prevention or obstruction carries ten years' imprisonment.
Knowing continued participation after prevention carries five years.

history.summary: Section 80 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the R.E. 2022 government-hosted Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory threshold and sequence should be proved from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Requirements such as reasonable time, authorised actors and reasonable necessity materially limit the provision's operation.

debateQuestion: Je, statutory conditions zote za section 80 zimetimizwa kwa facts husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
